_comment: MEASURED baseline for the synthetic AF bank — the reference the regression rule in
synthetic-af-bank-expectations.json ('regressionRule') compares against. That file holds
ASPIRATIONAL bands; this one holds what was actually measured.
PROVENANCE: transcribed verbatim from the V2 table in docs/synthetic-af-bank-baseline-results.md
(lines 115-134), which was produced by:
TestApp bank-verify --runs D:\SyntheticAutofocusBank --nc-sweep 2,3,4 --opt-a <A> --opt-b <B>
--pixel-scale header      (17 runs, 0 failed, schema afbank-verify/3)
These numbers are TRANSCRIBED, not regenerated. The optimizer prepass output directories that
produced configs A and B no longer exist, and the optimized_settings.json copies still sitting in
each dataset's attempt01/ folder are whichever prepass ran LAST (they show 5 datasets at
BrightnessSensitivity 0.0 — D09/D10/D11/D12/D17 — where the published config A had 6, including
D15). So config A as published cannot be re-scored from what is on disk; it has to be re-derived.
CAVEATS on reading the cells:
- 'recallHigh' on THIS bank is recall at golden peak SNR >= 20 (goldenHighSnr in
SynthBank/synthetic-bank-spec.json), NOT >= 12. The bank-verify markdown column header
'recall@SNR>=12' and the JSON field 'goldenSNRge12' are misnomers on the synthetic bank.
- 'precision' here is EXACT (synthetic truth is complete), unlike the real bank where it is a
lower bound (F11).
- Per-dataset sigmaFocus was NOT published in the V2 table, so it is absent here. The
sigmaFocusWorseFractionMax rule needs a same-session HEAD arm to score against.
- afR2 is the C0 value only; per-config afR2 was not published.
detectorCommit: unknown (pre-b3f7165; the V2 run predates the synth-validate eps fixes)

configs.B: optimize --per-run --donut landings (donut master forced on in bank-verify)

_comment: The config-A landed BrightnessSensitivity values recorded in the design spec's Evidence 1
(docs/af-recommender-hardening-design.md). Only the six-at-zero set was published by name;
the remaining eleven were reported only as an aggregate ('every dataset that landed above 2.5
scores >= 0.941'), so they are not enumerated here.
